IncidentBot: URGENT: regional-health-failover detector triggered  2778901234
IncidentBot: EU-west synthetic probes failing 10/10 over 3m; automated routing performed a partial failover to us-central (~30%). Paging: @Maya R. runbook: /runbooks/region-fallover
Maya R.: on it. any deploys in last 15m?
Zoe H.: no deploys in EU. But kube node churn started at 2778901201, some nodes showing OOMKilled.
Carlos D.: metrics: proxy 502s spiked to 18% of requests for a 3m window. Embeddings latency p95 up to 2.3s.
Anita P.: Support flagged three enterprise customers seeing timeouts for embed requests. Tickets #9088-9090.
Maya R.: mitigation: pause batch maintenance jobs, reduce batch concurrency hitting EU endpoints, spin up temporary larger instance types for proxy.
Theo L.: autoscaler is slow; I can temporarily override instance type pool to m-larger-2x. Doing it now.
OpsBot: override executed by Theo L.  pool: eu-proxy-pool -> m-larger-2x (3 instances)
Maya R.: alerts: current region-failover policy pages on 4 probes failing in 3m. that's causing repeated pager noise with transient network blips. Propose raising to 6/6m and adding a 15m refractory after any routing change.
Zoe H.: also reduce sensitivity on the proxy 5xx pager: change to page only if >8% of region QPS sustained for 5m. Otherwise send to channel.
Carlos D.: agree. I'll prepare the alert change. Also add a Grafana view for multi-region synthetic vs routing weight so we can visually correlate.
Anita P.: I've told CSMs and posted an update to impacted tickets. Customers asking if the incident was caused by infra autoscaling.
Maya R.: for handoff: I'll remain until error rate <2% for 15m. Then hand to Zoe. Zoe, please confirm refractory suppression and merge the alert PR.
Theo L.: new instances up at 2778901350. shifting traffic back slowly. error rate drops to 4% now.
IncidentBot: Alert policy modified by Carlos D.  region-failover thresholds updated
Maya R.: add to post-incident: - make autoscaler healthcheck alert more prominent in oncall dashboard - add unit tests to CI for healthcheck endpoint under high-load - create a runbook section for routing-change suppression logic
Carlos D.: PR #5201 for alert tuning created. sample rule: 
```
alert: regional_failover
expr: sum(fail_probe{region="eu-west"}[6m]) > 6
for: 6m
annotations:
  severity: page-if-high-traffic
  runbook: /runbooks/region-failover
```
Zoe H.: merging and will observe. Also adding a panel that annotates recent routing changes.
Anita P.: customers notified. we'll follow up with a more detailed postmortem in 48h.
Maya R.: good job. leaving handoff notes and will close if stable at 2778901599. thanks all. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE  monitoring
